name: Michelin
verdict: Brand of Compagnie Générale des Établissements Michelin (SCA since 1951); as of 31 December 2025 its largest disclosed holders are asset managers BlackRock (6.12%), Capital Group (5.07%) and Mage Invest (4.41%), with no other shareholder above 5%. Nothing found.
note: Official Tyre of MotoGP (motogp.com/en/sponsors) and team partner of Team Picnic PostNL from 2026. Rating note: CGEM is a partnership limited by shares (michelin.com corporate governance); its 2025 Universal Registration Document (section 2.11) discloses BlackRock 6.12%, Capital Group 5.07%, Mage Invest 4.41% of share capital and no other shareholder above 5% at 31 December 2025 — asset managers and institutions, no state or state-fund shareholder; the same section notes Capital Group crossed 10% of the share capital in March 2026 (still a private US asset-management group). No human-rights finding against Michelin found.
